title: Add consistent Studio keyboard shortcuts
body:
Add consistent keyboard access to Studio actions: Ctrl+Shift+M maximize/restore focused panel, F11 fullscreen, Ctrl+Shift+I Inspector, Ctrl+Shift+P capture frame, Ctrl+Shift+R recording, Ctrl+S Save, Ctrl+Shift+S Save as, Ctrl+Shift+E export, Ctrl+Enter Build. Reuse existing actions and visible hints; preserve capability disabled reasons, native window controls and focus/layout restoration.

Press ? (Shift+/) to open a keyboard-shortcuts reference modal, generated from the shared shortcut definitions. Provide a visible menu entry, accessible focus handling, Escape/Close and focus restoration. Do not intercept ordinary question-mark typing in Source/input/contenteditable, IME, repeat events or other dialogs. Show a generic Restore workspace affordance and Ctrl+Shift+M hint for every maximized panel.

Checklist: implement; focused CPU and isolated actual keyboard/modal/screenshots; independent design/UX/source review; serial integration and combined skill install/check. Preserve saved layouts and live Preview canvas. Supersedes prior reviewed candidate's missing restore affordance; correct full source hashes in replacement evidence.
reason: User requested ? reference modal; independent review requires generic visible restoration.
